PART 2: calculate residual traits

```{r residual analysis for relatieve residual mass}

# --- Data voorbereiden ---
tmp <- mayflies_lab_long_clean %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c("ind_code", "distance", "location", "transect", "distance_log", "date_sample_num"),
    names_from = parameter,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    dry_weight_log     = log(dry_weight),
    body_length_log    = log(body_length),
    pronotum_width_log = log(pronotum_width),
    mesonotum_width_log = log(mesonotum_width),
    wing_area_log      = log(wing_area)
  )

# --- Model fitten (alleen 0m individuen) ---
m_fit_loglog0m_int <- lm(
  dry_weight_log ~ body_length_log * pronotum_width_log * mesonotum_width_log * wing_area_log,
  data = tmp %>% filter(distance == 0)
)

m_fit_loglog0m <- lm(
  dry_weight_log ~ body_length_log + pronotum_width_log + mesonotum_width_log + wing_area_log,
  data = tmp %>% filter(distance == 0)
)

AIC(m_fit_loglog0m, m_fit_loglog0m_int) # interactiemodel veel hogere AIC.

model <- m_fit_loglog0m

# --- MODEL-LEVEL RESULTATEN ---
tidy_mod <- tidy(model)
n_obs <- nobs(model)

# R2
r2 <- suppressWarnings(r.squaredGLMM(model))
r2_tab <- r2beta(model, method = "nsj", partial = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  select(Effect, Rsq) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Effect, values_from = Rsq) 
  
# logLik en df
logLik_val <- logLik(model)
df_val <- attr(logLik_val, "df")

# VIF
vif_check <- tryCatch(max(vif(model)), error = function(e) NA)

# AIC
aic_val <- AIC(model)

# Bouw tabel
final_results_residual <- tibble(
  model           = "loglog0m",
  n_obs           = n_obs,
  df_val          = df_val,
  aic_full        = aic_val,
  logLik          = as.numeric(logLik_val),
  r2_marginal     = r2[1, "R2m"],
  r2_conditional  = r2[1, "R2c"],
  vif_max         = vif_check
) %>%
  bind_cols(r2_tab)

fwrite(final_results_residual, "final_results_residual_int.csv")

# --- EFFECT-LEVEL RESULTATEN ---
# Coefficienten + BH-correctie
model.summary <- summary(model)$coefficients %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Effect") %>%
  transmute(
    Effect,
    Estimate,
    p.adj = p.adjust(`Pr(>|t|)`, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  filter(Effect != "(Intercept)")

# dAIC berekenen per term
drop_terms <- c("body_length_log", "pronotum_width_log", "mesonotum_width_log", "wing_area_log")
aic_drop <- sapply(drop_terms, function(trm) {
  m_drop <- update(model, paste0(". ~ . - ", trm))
  AIC(m_drop)
}) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Effect")

names(aic_drop) <- c("Effect", "AIC")
aic_drop <- aic_drop %>%
  mutate(dAIC = AIC - AIC(model)) %>%
  select(Effect, dAIC)

# R2 per predictor
r2_tab_effects <- r2beta(model, method = "nsj", partial = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  select(Effect, Rsq)

# Tabel samenvoegen
final_results_residual_formatted <- r2_tab_effects %>%
  left_join(model.summary, by = "Effect") %>%
  left_join(aic_drop, by = "Effect") %>%
  transmute(Parameter = Effect,
            R2 = round(Rsq, digits=2),
            Slope = round(Estimate, digits=2),
            `p-value` = case_when(is.na(p.adj) ~ "",
                                  p.adj <= 0.001 ~ "< 0.001",
                                  p.adj <= 0.01  ~ "< 0.01",
                                  p.adj <= 0.05  ~ "< 0.05",  
                                  TRUE        ~ "n.s."))

fwrite(final_results_residual_formatted, "final_results_residual_formatted.csv")

# --- Residuen berekenen voor ALLE individuen ---
tmp <- tmp %>%
  filter(!is.na(body_length) & !is.na(pronotum_width) & !is.na(mesonotum_width) &
           !is.na(wing_area) & !is.na(dry_weight)) %>%
  mutate(
    dry_weight_predicted = exp(predict(m_fit_loglog0m, newdata = .)),
    dry_weight_predicted_relative = 100 * dry_weight_predicted / dry_weight,
    dry_weight_residual = dry_weight - dry_weight_predicted,
    dry_weight_residual_relative = 100 * dry_weight_residual / dry_weight
  )

# Toevoegen aan long-format dataset
residual_abs <- mayflies_lab_long_clean %>%
  filter(parameter == "dry_weight" & ind_code %in% tmp$ind_code) %>%
  left_join(tmp %>% select(ind_code, dry_weight_predicted_relative), by = "ind_code") %>%
  mutate(parameter = "dry_weight_predicted_relative",
         value = dry_weight_predicted_relative) %>%
  select(-dry_weight_predicted_relative)

residual_rel <- mayflies_lab_long_clean %>%
  filter(parameter == "dry_weight" & ind_code %in% tmp$ind_code) %>%
  left_join(tmp %>% select(ind_code, dry_weight_residual_relative), by = "ind_code") %>%
  mutate(parameter = "dry_weight_residual_relative",
         value = dry_weight_residual_relative) %>%
  select(-dry_weight_residual_relative)

mayflies_lab_long_clean <- bind_rows(mayflies_lab_long_clean, residual_abs, residual_rel)

# Opschonen
rm(tmp, residual_abs, residual_rel, model, r2, r2_tab, r2_tab_effects, aic_drop, model.summary,
   tidy_mod, logLik_val, df_val, vif_check, aic_val, n_obs, m_fit_loglog0m)
 
```


PART 3: PCA on traits

```{r PCA on traits}

test <- mayflies_lab_long_clean %>% 
  filter(!parameter == "dry_weight_predicted_relative") %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = 1:9, names_from = parameter, values_from = value) 


test_pca <- test[,c(7,10,12,13,14)]  %>%
  na.omit
#  mutate_if(is.numeric, log10) %>%

# test_pca <- test_pca[rowSums(is.na(test_pca)) <= 1, ]

# library(missMDA)
# test_pca_imp <- imputePCA(test_pca[,c(-1)], ncp =2)

test_pca_res <- prcomp(test_pca[,c(-1)], scale = T)

summary(test_pca_res)
test_pca_res.df <- summary(test_pca_res)$importance %>% as.data.frame %>%
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits=3)
test_pca_res.df$Statistic <- row.names(test_pca_res.df)
fwrite(test_pca_res.df, "test_pca_res.df.csv")

test_pca_res.df.loading <- summary(test_pca_res)$rotation %>% as.data.frame %>%
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits=3)
test_pca_res.df.loading$Parameter <- row.names(test_pca_res.df.loading)
fwrite(test_pca_res.df.loading, "test_pca_res.df.loading.csv")

test_pca$pca_ax1 <- test_pca_res$x[,1]
test_pca$pca_ax2 <- test_pca_res$x[,2]
names(test_pca)

test_pca <- test_pca %>% select(-c(2:5)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(2,3), names_to = "parameter", values_to = "value")

test_pca <- mayflies_lab_long_clean %>% select(-value, -parameter) %>% 
  unique() %>%
  left_join(test_pca) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value))

mayflies_lab_long_clean <- mayflies_lab_long_clean %>% 
  bind_rows(test_pca)
```

```{r correlation}
cor_traits <- rcorr(cor_traits, type = "spearman")

par_order <-  c("dry_weight", "dry_weight_residual_relative","pca_ax1", "body_length", "pronotum_width", "mesonotum_width", "wing_area")

facets_cor <- c(
  "body_length" = "Body length",
  "pronotum_width" = "Pronotum\nwidth",
  "mesonotum_width" = "Mesonotum\nwidth",
  "wing_area" = "Wing area",
  "dry_weight" = "Dry weight",

  #"dry_weight_predicted_relative" = "Predicted dry weight (%)"
  "pca_ax1" = "Body size\nindex"

cor_traits_r <- cor_traits$r %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(parameter_x = row.names(cor_traits$r)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols =1:ncol(.)-1, names_to = "parameter_y", values_to = "r") %>%
  mutate(parameter_x = factor(parameter_x, levels = par_order),
         parameter_y = factor(parameter_y, levels = rev(par_order))) %>%
  filter(!parameter_x==parameter_y) %>%
  filter(!parameter_x == "dry_weight") %>%
  mutate(ix = match(parameter_x, par_order), iy = match(parameter_y, par_order), r  = ifelse(ix <= iy, NA, r)) %>%
  select(-ix, -iy)

cor_traits_p <- cor_traits$P %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(parameter_x = row.names(cor_traits$P)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols =1:ncol(.)-1, names_to = "parameter_y", values_to = "p") %>%
  mutate(parameter_x = factor(parameter_x, levels = par_order),
         parameter_y = factor(parameter_y, levels = rev(par_order))) %>%
  filter(!parameter_x==parameter_y) %>%
  filter(!parameter_x == "dry_weight") %>%
    mutate(ix = match(parameter_x, par_order), iy = match(parameter_y, par_order), p  = ifelse(ix <= iy, NA, p)) %>%
  select(-ix, -iy)

cor_traits_full <- cor_traits_p %>% 
  left_join(cor_traits_r) %>%
   mutate(p.round = round(p.adjust(p, method="hol"), digits=2),
          r.round = case_when(p <= 0.05 & p > 0.01 ~ paste0(format(round(r, digits=2), nsmall=2), "*"),
                              p <= 0.01 & p > 0.001 ~ paste0(format(round(r, digits=2), nsmall=2), "**"),
                              p <= 0.001 ~ paste0(format(round(r, digits=2), nsmall=2), "***"),
                              .default = as.character(format(round(r, digits=2), nsmall=2)))) %>%
  #filter(!parameter_y == "wing_area") %>%
  filter(!is.na(p))


corr.traits_new <- cor_traits_full %>%
```

PART 4: NUMBERS IN TOTAL AND PER TRAP

```{r total numbers vs. distance model}

mayflies_field_total <- mayflies_field %>% 
  mutate(distance_log = log(distance+1)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(distance_log, distance, sex) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(value = sum(mayflies, na.rm=T)) %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  mutate(value_perc = value / sum(value, na.rm=T))

mayflies_total_lm <- lm(value ~ distance_log * sex,
      data = mayflies_field_total)

mayflies_total_glm <- glm(value ~ distance_log * sex,
      family = poisson(),
      data = mayflies_field_total)

AIC(mayflies_total_glm, mayflies_total_lm) # mayflies_total_lm laagste AIC!

selected.model <- get(AIC(mayflies_total_glm, mayflies_total_lm) %>% rownames_to_column() %>% as.data.frame %>%
  filter(AIC==min(AIC)) %>% pull(rowname) %>% as.character())

summary(selected.model)
r2beta(selected.model)

mayflies_field_total.pvals <- emtrends(mayflies_total_lm, ~ sex, var = "distance_log") %>%
  summary(infer=T) %>%
  mutate(p.value.full = p.adjust(p.value, method="BH"),
  p.value = case_when(
    p.value.full <= 0.001 ~ "p <= 0.001",
    p.value.full <= 0.01 ~ "p <= 0.01",
    p.value.full <= 0.05  ~ "p <= 0.05",
    TRUE                 ~ "n.s."
))
  
print(mayflies_field_total.pvals)

mayflies_field_total_predict <- emmeans(mayflies_total_lm, ~ distance_log | sex, 
                         at = list(distance_log = log(seq(0, 150, length.out = 151) + 1)), type = "response") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(distance = exp(distance_log)-1) %>%
  left_join(mayflies_field_total.pvals[,c(1,9)]) %>%
  mutate(lower.CL = case_when(lower.CL <0 ~ 0,
```

```{r per trap numbers vs. distance model}

mayflies_field_pertrap <- mayflies_field %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(distance_log = log(distance+1),
         loc_trans = interaction(location, transect))

mayflies.no.lm <- lmer(mayflies ~ distance_log * sex + (1 | loc_trans), 
                       data = mayflies_field_pertrap, REML=T)
mayflies.no.glm <-glmer(mayflies ~ distance_log * sex + (1 | loc_trans), 
                         data = mayflies_field_pertrap, 
                         family = poisson)
mayflies.no.glm.negbin <-glmmTMB(mayflies ~ distance_log * sex + (1 | loc_trans), 
                         data = mayflies_field_pertrap, 
                         family = nbinom2)

model_names <- data.frame(
  model = ls(),
  keep = (startsWith(ls(),"mayflies.no."))) %>%
  filter(keep==T) %>%
  pull(model)

models <- mget(model_names)

model_compare_pertrap <- data.frame(
  model = model_names,
  formula = sapply(models, function(m) paste(deparse(summary(m)$call), collapse = "")),
  AIC = sapply(models, AIC),
  BIC = sapply(models, BIC),
  logLik = sapply(models, function(m) as.numeric(logLik(m))),
  
  # Safe marginal R² extraction
  R2m = sapply(models, function(m) {
    if (inherits(m, "merMod") || inherits(m, "glmmTMB")) {
      suppressWarnings(r.squaredGLMM(m)[1, "R2m"])
    } else {
      NA
    }
  }),
  
  # Safe conditional R² extraction
  R2c = sapply(models, function(m) {
    if (inherits(m, "merMod") || inherits(m, "glmmTMB")) {
      suppressWarnings(r.squaredGLMM(m)[1, "R2c"])
    } else {
      NA
    }
  })
) %>%
  mutate(
    dAIC = AIC - min(AIC, na.rm = TRUE),
    dBIC = BIC - min(BIC, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits = 3)

print(model_compare_pertrap)
model_of_choice_pertrap <- get(model_compare_pertrap %>% filter(dAIC == 0) %>% pull(model))
print(model_of_choice_pertrap)

mayflies_field_pertrap_predict <- expand.grid(
  distance_log = log(seq(0, 150, length.out = 151) + 1),
  sex = levels(as.factor(mayflies_field_pertrap$sex))) %>%
  #filter(!sexclutch == "m_yes") %>%
  mutate(distance = exp(distance_log) - 1)

mayflies_field_pertrap_predict$value <- predict(model_of_choice_pertrap, newdata = mayflies_field_pertrap_predict, type = "response", re.form = ~0)

mayflies_field_pertrap.pvals <- emtrends(model_of_choice_pertrap, ~ sex, var = "distance_log") %>%
  summary(infer=T) %>%
  mutate(p.value.full = p.adjust(p.value, method="BH"),
  p.value = case_when(p.value.full <= 0.001 ~ "p <= 0.001",
                      p.value.full <= 0.01 ~ "p <= 0.01",
                      p.value.full <= 0.05  ~ "p <= 0.05",
                      TRUE                 ~ "n.s."))

print(mayflies_field_pertrap.pvals)

mayflies_field_pertrap_predict <- emmeans(model_of_choice_pertrap, ~ distance_log | sex, 
                         at = list(distance_log = log(seq(0, 150, length.out = 151) + 1)), type = "response") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(distance = exp(distance_log)-1) %>%
  left_join(mayflies_field_pertrap.pvals[,c(1,9)]) %>%
  mutate(asymp.LCL = case_when(asymp.LCL <0 ~ 0,
                               .default = asymp.LCL))
```

PART 5: RUN AND PLOT MODELS ON DISTANCE + DATE.

```{r select the best models and create summary table}

# wing_loading <- mayflies_lab_long_clean %>% filter(parameter %in% c("dry_weight", "wing_area")) %>%
#   pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, values_from = value) %>%
#   mutate(value = dry_weight / wing_area,
#          parameter = "wing_loading")

mayflies_lab_long_model <-  mayflies_lab_long_clean %>%
  # bind_rows(wing_loading) %>%
  mutate(value = case_when(parameter %in% c("body_length", "dry_weight", "wing_area",
                                            "pronotum_width", "mesonotum width") ~ log(value),
                           .default = value)) %>%
  filter(parameter %in% c("dry_weight_residual_relative", "dry_weight", "pca_ax1", "wing_loading")) %>%
  mutate(parameter = droplevels(as.factor(parameter)))

results <- list()
plots.norm.qq <- list()
plots.norm.res <- list()

for (parm in unique(mayflies_lab_long_model$parameter)) {
  print(parm)
  
  parm_facet <- facets_clean_noenter_nounit %>% as.data.frame %>%
    rownames_to_column("parameter") %>%
    transmute(parameter, parameter_facet = .data[["."]]) %>%
    filter(parameter == parm) %>%
    pull(parameter_facet)
       
  tmp <- mayflies_lab_long_model %>%
    filter(parameter == parm) %>%
    mutate(site_id = interaction(location, transect, drop=T))
    

  mod.lm.norm <- lmer(value ~ distance + date_sample_num + (1|site_id), 
                      data = tmp, REML = FALSE)
  
  summary(mod.lm.norm)
  AIC(mod.lm.norm)

  plot.data <- tibble(residuals = residuals(mod.lm.norm),
  fitted = fitted(mod.lm.norm))
  
  plots.norm.qq[[length(plots.norm.qq) + 1]] <- 
     plot.data %>%
  ggplot( aes(sample = residuals)) +
    stat_qq() +
    stat_qq_line() +
  labs(x = "Theoretical quantiles", y = "Sample quantiles") +
      labs(x = "Residuals", y = "Frequency", title = parm_facet) +
     my_theme+
    theme(axis.title.y = element_text())
 
  plots.norm.res[[length(plots.norm.res) + 1]] <- 
   plot.data %>%
   ggplot(aes(x = fitted, y = residuals)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(x = "Fitted values", y = "Residuals")+
    my_theme+
    theme(axis.title.y = element_text())
  
  tidy_mod <- tidy(mod.lm.norm, effects = "fixed")
    n_obs = nobs(mod.lm.norm)
    
    r2 <- suppressWarnings(r.squaredGLMM(mod.lm.norm))

    r2_tab <- r2beta(mod.lm.norm, method = "nsj", partial = TRUE) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      select(Effect, Rsq) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from  = Effect, values_from = Rsq)
    
    aic_drop <- sapply(c("distance", "date_sample_num"), function(trm) {
      m_drop <- update(mod.lm.norm, paste0(". ~ . - ", trm))
      AIC(m_drop)
    }) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column()
    
    names(aic_drop) <- c("parameter", "aic")
    
    row_distance <- tidy_mod %>% filter(term == "distance")
    row_date <- tidy_mod %>% filter(term == "date_sample_num")
 
    logLik_val = logLik(mod.lm.norm)
    df_val = attr(logLik_val, "df")
    
    vif_check = tryCatch(max(mod.lm.norm), error = function(e) NA)
    
    res <- tibble(
      parameter = parm,
      n_obs = n_obs,
      df_val = df_val,
      vif_check = vif_check,
      
      # aics
      aic_full = AIC(mod.lm.norm),
      aic_distance = aic_drop$aic[aic_drop$parameter == "distance"],
      aic_date = aic_drop$aic[aic_drop$parameter == "date_sample_num"],
      
      # r2
      r2_marginal = r2[1, "R2m"],
      r2_distance = r2_tab[1, "distance"]%>% as.numeric(),
      r2_date = r2_tab[1, "date_sample_num"] %>% as.numeric(),
      r2_conditional = r2[1, "R2c"],
      r2_reff = r2_conditional - r2_marginal,
      
      # p values
      p_distance = row_distance$p.value,
      p_date = row_date$p.value,
      
      # standard errors      
      se_distance = row_distance$std.error,
      se_date = row_date$std.error,

      # estimates
      estimate_distance = row_distance$estimate,
      estimate_date = row_date$estimate,
    )

    results[[length(results) + 1]] <- res
  }

plots.norm.qq[-1] <- lapply(
  plots.norm.qq[-1],
  function(p)
    p + theme(
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    )
)

plots.norm.res[-1] <- lapply(
  plots.norm.res[-1],
  function(p)
    p + theme(
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    )
)


n_models <- length(plots.norm.res)

row.qq   <- ggarrange(plotlist = plots.norm.qq,   ncol = n_models, nrow = 1, align = "hv")+
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = "a", hjust = -.1, vjust = 1.3, size = 3, fontface = "bold")
row.res  <- ggarrange(plotlist = plots.norm.res,  ncol = n_models, nrow = 1, align = "hv")+
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = "b", hjust = -.1, vjust = 1.3, size = 3, fontface = "bold")

final_plot <- ggarrange(row.qq, row.res,
                        ncol = 1,
                        heights = c(1, 1),
                        align = "hv")
print(final_plot)
ggsave("models_norm.png", width = figwidthfull_mm, height = figwidthfull_mm/2, units = "mm", dpi = 1200)
ggsave("models_norm.pdf", width = figwidthfull_mm, height = figwidthfull_mm/2, units = "mm", dpi = 1200)
ggsave("models_norm.eps", width = figwidthfull_mm, height = figwidthfull_mm/2, units = "mm", dpi = 1200)


all_p <- c(results$p_distance, results$p_date)
all_p_adj <- p.adjust(all_p, method = "BH")

final_results <- bind_rows(results) 

all_p <- c(final_results$p_distance, final_results$p_date)
all_p_adj <- p.adjust(all_p, method = "BH")

final_results  <- final_results %>%
  mutate(
    # p_distance_adj = p.adjust(p_distance, method = "BH"),
    # p_date_adj = p.adjust(p_date, method = "BH"),
    p_distance_adj = all_p_adj[1:n()],
    p_date_adj = all_p_adj[(n() + 1):(2 * n())]
  )
  
final_results_formatted <- final_results %>%
   left_join(tibble(parameter = names(facets_clean),  parameter_label = as.character(facets_clean))) %>%
  transmute(parameter = parameter_label, 
            N = n_obs, 
            #aic_full, 
            
            # full model
            `r2_marg (full)` = r2_marginal, 
            `r2_cond (full)` = r2_conditional, 
            #`r2_marg (random effects)` = r2_reff,
            
            `estimate (distance)` = ifelse(parameter=="dry_weight (mg)", exp(estimate_distance), estimate_distance),
            `r2 (distance)` = r2_distance, 
            `p-value (distance)` = case_when(p_distance_adj <= 0.001 ~ "< 0.001",
                                         p_distance_adj <= 0.01  ~ "< 0.01",
                                         p_distance_adj <= 0.05  ~ "< 0.05",  
                                         TRUE        ~ "n.s."),
            `estimate (date)`  = ifelse(parameter=="dry_weight (mg)", exp(estimate_date), estimate_date),
            `r2 (date)` = r2_date, 
            `p-value (date)` = case_when(p_date_adj <= 0.001 ~ "< 0.001",
                                         p_date_adj <= 0.01  ~ "< 0.01",
                                         p_date_adj <= 0.05  ~ "< 0.05",  
                                         TRUE        ~ "n.s.")) %>%
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, 3)
  
fwrite(final_results, "final_results.csv")
fwrite(final_results_formatted, "final_results_formatted.csv", encoding = "UTF-8")
```

```{r distance and date predict with selected models}

distances.interpolated.cl.tmp <- distances.interpolated.cl[,c(1,2)]
dates.interpolated.cl.tmp <- dates.interpolated.cl[,c(1)]

for (parm in unique(mayflies_lab_long_model$parameter)) {
  print(parm)
    
  tmp <- mayflies_lab_long_model %>%
    filter(parameter == parm) %>%
    mutate(site_id = interaction(location, transect, drop=T))
  
    model <- lmer(value ~ distance + date_sample_num + (1|site_id), 
                      data = tmp, REML = FALSE)
      
     # voor distance de geinterpoleerde waarden en confidence levels   
    
    distances.interpolated <- distances.interpolated %>%
      mutate(!!parm := emmeans(model, ~ distance, 
             at = list(distance = seq(0, 150, length.out = 151))) %>% 
             as.data.frame() %>%
             pull(emmean))
    
    distances.interpolated <- distances.interpolated %>%
      mutate(!!parm := emmeans(model, ~ distance, 
             at = list(distance = seq(0, 150, length.out = 151))) %>% 
             as.data.frame() %>%
             pull(emmean))
    
    cl_tmp <- emmeans(model, ~ distance, 
            at = list(distance = seq(0, 150, length.out = 151))) %>% as.data.frame() 
    
    distances.interpolated.cl.tmp <- distances.interpolated.cl[,c(1,2)]
    
    distances.interpolated.cl.tmp <- distances.interpolated.cl.tmp %>% 
      left_join(cl_tmp) %>%
      select(-emmean, -SE, -df) %>%
      mutate(parameter = parm)
    
    distances.interpolated.cl <- bind_rows(distances.interpolated.cl, distances.interpolated.cl.tmp)
      
    
    # voor date de geinterpoleerde waarden en confidence levels
    
    dates.interpolated <- dates.interpolated %>%
      mutate(!!parm := emmeans(model, ~ date_sample_num, 
             at = list(date_sample_num = seq(min(mayflies_lab_long_clean$date_sample_num), 
                        max(mayflies_lab_long_clean$date_sample_num), 
                        length.out = 100))) %>% 
             as.data.frame() %>%
             pull(emmean))
    
    cl_tmp <- emmeans(model, ~ date_sample_num, 
              at = list(date_sample_num = seq(min(mayflies_lab_long_clean$date_sample_num), 
                        max(mayflies_lab_long_clean$date_sample_num), 
                        length.out = 100))) %>% 
              as.data.frame()
    
    dates.interpolated.cl.tmp <- dates.interpolated.cl[,c(1)]
    
    dates.interpolated.cl.tmp <- dates.interpolated.cl.tmp %>% 
      left_join(cl_tmp) %>%
      select(-emmean, -SE, -df) %>%
      mutate(parameter = parm)
  
    dates.interpolated.cl <- bind_rows(dates.interpolated.cl, dates.interpolated.cl.tmp)
  }

rm(distances.interpolated.cl.tmp)
    
distances.interpolated.long <- 
  distances.interpolated %>%
  pivot_longer(!1:2, names_to = "parameter", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(value = ifelse(parameter == "dry_weight", exp(value), value))
```

```{r distance plots of selected models}

facet_labeling_distance <- mayflies_lab_long_clean %>%
  filter(parameter %in% mayflies_lab_long_model$parameter) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(distance, parameter) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
              sd_val = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),  
              n = sum(!is.na(value)),
              ci_lower = mean - (sd_val / sqrt(n)), # dit is SE, is eigenlijk beter.
              ci_upper = mean + (sd_val / sqrt(n)), # dit is SE, is eigenlijk beter.
              # ci_lower = mean - 1.96 * (sd_val / sqrt(n)),
              # ci_upper = mean + 1.96 * (sd_val / sqrt(n))
             ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  mutate(max_ci = max(ci_upper),
         min_ci = min(ci_lower)) %>%
  left_join(facets_df) %>%
  ungroup %>%
  left_join(distances.interpolated.cl %>% group_by(parameter) %>% summarise(max_ci2 = max(upper.CL))) %>%
  left_join(distances.interpolated.cl %>% group_by(parameter) %>% summarise(min_ci2 = min(lower.CL))) %>%
  mutate(max_ci_distance = case_when(max_ci < max_ci2 ~ max_ci2,
                            .default = max_ci),
         min_ci_distance = case_when(min_ci < min_ci2 ~ min_ci,
                            .default = min_ci2)) %>%
  select(parameter, max_ci_distance, min_ci_distance, facets) %>%
  left_join(distances.interpolated.long %>% dplyr::filter(distance == 0) %>% dplyr::select(parameter, p_distance_adj)) %>%
  unique() %>%
  mutate(p_label = case_when(is.na(p_distance_adj) ~ "",
                                  p_distance_adj <= 0.001 ~ "p <= 0.001",
                                  p_distance_adj <= 0.01  ~ "p <= 0.01",
                                  p_distance_adj <= 0.05  ~ "p <= 0.05",  
                                  TRUE        ~ "n.s.")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-p_distance_adj) 

facet_labeling_date <- mayflies_lab_long_clean %>%
  filter(parameter %in% mayflies_lab_long_model$parameter) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(date_sample_num, parameter) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
              sd_val = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),  
              n = sum(!is.na(value)),
              ci_lower = mean - (sd_val / sqrt(n)), # dit is SE, is eigenlijk beter.
              ci_upper = mean + (sd_val / sqrt(n)), # dit is SE, is eigenlijk beter.
              # ci_lower = mean - 1.96 * (sd_val / sqrt(n)),
              # ci_upper = mean + 1.96 * (sd_val / sqrt(n))
              ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  mutate(max_ci = max(ci_upper),
         min_ci = min(ci_lower)) %>%
  left_join(facets_df) %>%
  ungroup %>%
  left_join(dates.interpolated.cl %>% group_by(parameter) %>% summarise(max_ci2 = max(upper.CL))) %>%
  left_join(dates.interpolated.cl %>% group_by(parameter) %>% summarise(min_ci2 = min(lower.CL))) %>%
  mutate(max_ci_date = case_when(max_ci < max_ci2 ~ max_ci2,
                            .default = max_ci),
         min_ci_date = case_when(min_ci < min_ci2 ~ min_ci,
                            .default = min_ci2)) %>%
  select(parameter, max_ci_date, min_ci_date, facets) %>%
  left_join(dates.interpolated.long %>% dplyr::filter(date_sample_num == 1) %>% 
              dplyr::select(parameter, p_date_adj)) %>%
  unique() %>%
  mutate(p_label_date = case_when(is.na(p_date_adj) ~ "",
                                  p_date_adj <= 0.001 ~ "p <= 0.001",
                                  p_date_adj <= 0.01  ~ "p <= 0.01",
                                  p_date_adj <= 0.05  ~ "p <= 0.05",  
                                  TRUE        ~ "n.s.")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-p_date_adj, -facets) %>%
  mutate(facets_date = c("d", "e", "f")) 


facet_labeling <- facet_labeling_date %>% left_join(facet_labeling_distance) %>%
  mutate(min_ci = pmin(min_ci_date, min_ci_distance),
         max_ci = pmax(max_ci_date, max_ci_distance))


plot.distance <- 
  mayflies_lab_long_clean %>%
  filter(parameter %in% mayflies_lab_long_model$parameter) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(distance, parameter) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
              median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
              sd_val = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),  
              n = sum(!is.na(value)),
              sdmin = case_when((mean - sd_val) < 0 ~ 0, TRUE ~ (mean - sd_val)),
              sdmax = mean + sd_val,
              ci_lower = mean - (sd_val / sqrt(n)), # dit is SE, is eigenlijk beter.
              ci_upper = mean + (sd_val / sqrt(n))) %>% # dit is SE, is eigenlijk beter.
              # ci_lower = mean - 1.96 * (sd_val / sqrt(n)),
              # ci_upper = mean + 1.96 * (sd_val / sqrt(n))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(facet_labeling) %>%
  ggplot() +
  
  # gemeten waarden
  geom_point(aes(y=mean, x=distance), size=2, shape=shapes.1)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = distance, ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), inherit.aes = T, width=3, size=.2)+
  geom_text(aes(x = 0, y = max_ci +  0.0*(max_ci-min_ci), label = facets),
             hjust = 0, vjust = 1.2,
             size = 2, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_text(aes(x = 140, y = max_ci +  0.0*(max_ci-min_ci), label = p_label),
             hjust = 1, vjust = 1.2,
             size = 2, parse=T) +
  geom_blank(data = facet_labeling, aes(y = min_ci)) +
  geom_blank(data = facet_labeling, aes(y = max_ci)) +

   # modelvoorspellingen
  geom_line(data = distances.interpolated.long %>% dplyr::filter(p_distance_adj<0.05), 
            aes(y = value, x=distance),
            linewidth = .75, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "solid", "FALSE" = "dotted")) +

  geom_ribbon(data = distances.interpolated.cl %>% dplyr::filter(parameter %in% (distances.interpolated.long %>% 
                                                                                   dplyr::filter(p_distance_adj<0.05) %>% 
                                                                                   pull(parameter) %>% 
                                                                                   unique())),
              aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL, x=distance), alpha = 0.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,25,50,100,150))+ 
  xlab("Distance from the stream (m)")+
  my_theme+
  facet_nested_wrap(~fct_relevel(parameter, plot_order), scales="free_y", labeller=as_labeller(facets_clean),  
             strip.position = "left", ncol=1)
```
